parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The driver ID. In the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), go to the Driver Management page and hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the driver ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en: The driver version number. The version number must be unique for the driver. Two identical version numbers cannot be set for the same driver. The version number can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). The version number can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 驱动版本号。必须是该驱动唯一的版本号，即一个驱动不可以设置两个相同的版本号。允许中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和英文句号（.），长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: driver_version

parameters.help_en: The edge version that the driver is adapted to. The driver can run only on gateways with this edge version or later. For example, 2.4.0 indicates that the driver runs on gateways with edge version v2.4.0 or later
parameters.help_zh: 驱动适配的边缘版本，即该驱动只能在该边缘版本及以上版本的网关中运行。例如2.4.0，表示在v2.4.0及以上的边缘版本中运行该驱动
parameters.name: edge_version

parameters.help_en: The driver description. The description can be up to 256 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 驱动描述。长度不超过256个字节
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The source configuration of the driver code. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip"}`

In this format, `ossAddress` specifies the Object Storage Service (OSS) access address. To upload driver code and obtain the OSS address by calling an API operation, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
驱动代码来源配置。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

` {"ossAddress":"http://***/driver_code.zip"}`

其中，`ossAddress`为对象存储（OSS）访问地址，如需通过API的方式上传驱动代码并获取OSS地址，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html接口获取
parameters.name: source_config

parameters.help_en:
The driver configuration. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

The following section describes each parameter.

format: the configuration format. Valid values: KV (key-value pair), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).
content: the configuration content. If format is set to KV or JSON, specify the configuration content. If format is set to FILE, specify the OSS address. 

    > Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html operation to obtain the OSS address
parameters.help_zh:
驱动配置。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"format":"JSON","content":"{}"}`

参数说明如下所示。

format：配置格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）。
content：配置内容。format为KV或JSON时，请填配置内容；format为FILE时，请填OSS地址。 

    > OSS地址请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155858.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_config

parameters.help_en: The container configuration. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see the ContainerConfig table below
parameters.help_zh: 容器配置。JSON格式字符串。更多信息，请参见本文下方ContainerConfig表格
parameters.name: container_config

parameters.help_en:
The configuration check rule. The value is a JSON string in the following format:

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}`

The following section describes each parameter.

driverConfig: the configuration check rule for the driver in the edge instance.

deviceConfig: the configuration check rule for devices under the driver in the edge instance.

If `required` is set to true, the parameter cannot be empty. If `required` is set to false, the parameter can be empty
parameters.help_zh:
配置校验规则。JSON格式字符串，格式如下：

`{"deviceConfig":{"required":false},"driverConfig":{"required":false}`

参数说明如下。

driverConfig：表示边缘实例中该驱动的配置校验规则。

deviceConfig：表示边缘实例中该驱动下设备的配置校验规则。

`required`为true表示参数不能为空；false表示参数允许为空
parameters.name: config_check_rule

parameters.help_en: The JVM (Java Virtual Machine) startup parameters
parameters.name: argument

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates a successful call. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
